uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2921-6972-8329--225.easyPrerequisites: The Zombie Cat doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it and has base toughness 2 or greater.
2921-6972-8329--225.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the Zombie Cat.
When the Zombie Cat dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the Zombie Cat enters, Olag and Miau's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Zombie Cat.
Resolve the second trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on either a Zombie or Cat you control.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Repeat.
2921-6972-8329--225.notes: You can use either Olag and Miau trigger to put a +1/+1 counter on the Zombie Cat. The other ability can put the counter on any Zombie or Cat you control depending on which trigger is left.

3899-4681-6542-7747.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Giant-Sized Flying Ant, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Giant-Sized Flying Ant from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Giant-Sized Flying Ant enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Repeat.

225-1315-2693-5721.easyPrerequisites: Land cards in your graveyard and under your control can tap to add at least {4}{G}{B}.
225-1315-2693-5721.description:
Activate each untapped land you control by tapping it, adding mana.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it.
In response, activate Zuran Orb repeatedly by sacrificing each land you control, gaining life each time.
Resolve the Aftermath Analyst ability, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
For each land that enters, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers.
In response activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land you control.
Resolve one Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger from step 5, untapping it.
Repeat steps 6 and 7 for each land that entered.
Activate Phyrexian Reclamation by paying {1}{B} and 2 life, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G}.
Aftermath Analyst enters, triggering itself, causing you to mill three cards.

1409-2339-7839.description:
Activate Inferno Titan by paying {1}{U}, blinking it
When Inferno Titan enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Inferno Titan.
Resolve the Inferno Titan trigger, dealing 3 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating three Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.
1409-2339-7839.notes: Once you have infinite Treasures, Inferno Titan's damage can be redirected to any desired target(s).

5078-5901-7902.easyPrerequisites: Artist's Talent is at least level 2.
5078-5901-7902.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Artist's Talent.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Fateful Discovery triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Fateful Discovery trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library
Repeat

1251-1563-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
1251-1563-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
1251-1563-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 2 or greater

725-1432-7308.description:
Activate Mona Lisa by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color
Activate Ioreth's second ability by tapping it, untapping Mona Lisa and another legendary creature.
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping the other legendary creature, untapping Ioreth.
Repeat.

6797-6871-6879-7298.description:
Cast Firdoch Core by paying {3}.
When Firdoch Core enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Firdoch Core, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Firdoch Core.
When Firdoch Core dies, Haru triggers, returning Firdoch Core from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Firdoch Core enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Firdoch Core, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1308-5525-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
1308-5525-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Llanowar Loamspeaker
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

2060-4770-6556-6930.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {W}.
Spider-Man India triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

1621-4200.description:
Cast Icewind Stalwart by paying its mana cost.
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it triggers, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Icewind Stalwart.
Repeat from step 2.

440-1339-4050-6458.easyPrerequisites: Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
440-1339-4050-6458.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-1339-4050-6458.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {1}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

465-719-1849-3742-4251.notablePrerequisites: Xenograft on the battlefield with "Samurai" chosen.
465-719-1849-3742-4251.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

1046-1479-2783.notablePrerequisites: You have a basic Forest in hand.
1046-1479-2783.description:
Play a basic Forest card from your hand.
Kodama and Nesting Dragon trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield from your hand.
Holding priority, activate the basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a 0/2 Dragon Egg creature token.
When the Dragon Egg enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers.
Holding priority, activate Living Twister's second ability by paying {G}, returning the Forest from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting the Forest onto the battlefield from your hand.
When the Forest enters the battlefield, Nesting Dragon triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

708-2034-2500-2661-2895.notablePrerequisites: Gwenna does not have summoning sickness.
708-2034-2500-2661-2895.description:
Activate Mirage Mirror by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Myth Unbound until end of turn.
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding {G}{U} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or activate abilities of creatures.
Cast Uro from the command zone by paying {1}{G}{U}.
Gwenna triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and untapping itself.
Uro enters the battlefield, triggering its first and second abilities.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Uro, adding {C}{C}.
Choose to return Uro to the command zone from your graveyard.
Myth Unbound and Mirage Mirror each trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the first Uro trigger, causing you to not sacrifice Uro due to it no longer being on the battlefield.
Resolve the second Uro trigger, causing you to gain three life, draw a card, and put any land from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

913-3525-3784.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Vhal.
Vhal does not have summoning sickness.
913-3525-3784.description:
Activate Vhal by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C} that cannot be spent to cast spells from your hand.
Activate Signpost Scarecrow by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Vhal.
Repeat.

915-2364-3807.notablePrerequisites: Swift Reconfiguration attatched to Synod Artificer.
915-2364-3807.description:
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Synod Artificer's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping itself and Mana Vault.
Repeat.

215-1494-3843.description:
Cast Sage of Hours by paying {6}{U}, causing it to enter the battlefield with five +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you take at least one extra turn after this one.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Sage of Hours from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

2135-2503-3096.description:
Activate Elixir of Immortality by paying {2} and tapping it, causing you to gain five life and shuffle Elixir of Immortality and your graveyard into your library.
Cast Inverter of Truth by paying {2}{B}{B}.
Inverter of Truth enters the battlefield, exiling your library face down.
Activate Jace's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing target player to mill two cards and you to win the game due to drawing from an empty library.

uses.exileCardState: with a kick counter on it

249-1436-3094-4091.notablePrerequisites:
Zethi and Aphetto Alchemist do not have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {4}{W}.
249-1436-3094-4091.description:
Declare Zethi as an attacker, triggering its second ability.
Holding priority, activate all mana producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{W}.
Activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Zethi's triggered ability.
Resolve the copy of Zethi's ability, creating a copy of each card exiled with a kick counter of it and causing you to pay {1}{W} to cast the copy of Call to Glory.
Resolve the Call to Glory copy, untapping all creatures you control.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, untapping Lithoform Engine.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use that mana to then cast the copies of all other cards exiled with kick counters on them.

1274-1495.description:
Activate Heliod targeting Triskelion, giving it lifelink until end of turn.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it to deal 1 damage to any target, gaining you 1 life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelion.
Repeat from step 2 for infinite damage and lifegain.
